description: This file implements functions for formatting and parsing civil time types (e.g., CivilSecond, CivilMinute, CivilHour, CivilDay, CivilMonth, CivilYear) within the Abseil library, including normalization of years and flexible parsing.

classes.name: CivilYear
classes.description: Represents a civil year with formatting and parsing support.

classes.description: Represents a civil month with formatting and parsing support.

classes.name: CivilDay
classes.description: Represents a civil day with formatting and parsing support.

classes.name: CivilHour
classes.description: Represents a civil hour with formatting and parsing support.

classes.name: CivilMinute
classes.description: Represents a civil minute with formatting and parsing support.

classes.name: CivilSecond
classes.description: Represents a civil second with formatting and parsing support.

methods.description: Formats civil time objects into strings with specific formats.

methods.description: Parses strings into civil time objects with specific formats.
